title.en: What measurements do these files contain?
title.zh: 这些文件是什么测量，能做哪些分析？

inputs.en: Original vendor files, export definitions, units, cell IDs and test protocol.
inputs.zh: 需要仪器原始文件、导出列定义、单位、电池编号和测试程序。

gate.en: Select a verified format adapter. Preserve original values and provenance; do not infer experiment type from filename alone.
gate.zh: 先验证格式适配器，保留原始值与来源；不能只凭文件名认定实验类型。

title.en: How has the EIS spectrum changed?
title.zh: 不同阶段的 EIS 有什么变化？

inputs.en: Frequency, real/imaginary impedance, cell and diagnostic index; matched temperature, SOC and rest context.
inputs.zh: 需要频率、阻抗实部/虚部、电池编号与诊断序号；比较时需匹配温度、SOC 和静置条件。

gate.en: Connected now: public spectra, browser CPE fit and existing impedance.py references. No unique mechanism follows from a small residual.
gate.zh: 已接入：公开实测谱、浏览器 CPE 拟合、现有 impedance.py 参考。小残差不能确认唯一机制。

title.en: Can overlapping time constants be resolved?
title.zh: 重叠的阻抗过程能否进一步分辨？

inputs.en: Condition-matched EIS covering an adequate frequency range; noise and residual context.
inputs.zh: 需要条件匹配、频率范围足够的 EIS，以及噪声与残差信息。

gate.en: Check KK before DRT. Compare regularization choices; do not label every peak as a distinct physical process. Not connected to the live agent.
gate.zh: 先检查 KK，再检验正则化敏感性；不能把每个峰直接指定为物理过程。本对话尚未接入 DRT。

title.en: Where does capacity or efficiency change?
title.zh: 容量、效率在哪些阶段发生变化？

inputs.en: Time, current, voltage, step/cycle IDs and charge/discharge definitions.
inputs.zh: 需要时间、电流、电压、步骤/循环编号以及充放电容量定义。

gate.en: Check sign conventions, capacity resets, cutoffs and actual temperature/rate. Shared aging histories are not independent cells.
gate.zh: 核对正负号、容量清零、截止条件及温度/倍率；同一电池的多圈不能当成独立电池。

title.zh: dQ/dV 或 dV/dQ 的特征是否变化？

inputs.en: Suitable constant-current half-cycles with voltage/capacity resolution and current/temperature metadata.
inputs.zh: 需要合适的恒流半周期，足够的电压/容量分辨率，以及电流、温度记录。

tools: cellpy ICA / DVA or guarded local CSV tool

gate.en: Local CSV dQ/dV is available in the separate data tab; this conversation is not connected to uploaded data. Peaks alone do not quantify LLI/LAM.
gate.zh: 独立数据页已有受检查的 CSV dQ/dV；本对话尚未接入上传数据。单凭峰位变化不能定量给出 LLI/LAM。

title.en: Which electrode-level degradation modes fit the data?
title.zh: 哪些电极层面的衰减模式与数据相符？

inputs.en: Low-rate pseudo-OCV/full-cell curves and chemistry-matched positive/negative half-cell OCP references.
inputs.zh: 需要低倍率准 OCV/全电池曲线，以及化学体系匹配的正负极半电池 OCP 参考。

gate.en: Require relevant electrode references; report competing fits and uncertainty before LLI/LAM interpretation. No universal electrode curve is assumed.
gate.zh: 先取得匹配电极参考，检查多起点、拟合区间与替代解，再解释 LLI/LAM；不能套用通用电极曲线。

title.en: Does pulse resistance rise at matched SOC?
title.zh: 相同 SOC 下的脉冲电阻是否升高？

inputs.en: Time-resolved voltage and current around real current steps, pulse/rest IDs, SOC and temperature.
inputs.zh: 需要真实电流阶跃附近的时间、电流、电压，脉冲/静置编号、SOC 和温度。

gate.en: Report the time delay and sign convention. A 10-second resistance is not high-frequency ohmic resistance or a full EIS spectrum.
gate.zh: 明确采样延时与符号；10 秒电阻不等于高频欧姆电阻，更不是完整 EIS 谱。

title.en: What transport information can GITT support?
title.zh: GITT 能支持哪些扩散相关结论？

inputs.en: Galvanostatic pulses and relaxation, adequate time sampling, geometry/active-material inputs and model assumptions.
inputs.zh: 需要恒流脉冲与弛豫段、足够时间采样、几何/活性材料参数及模型假设。

gate.en: Assess relaxation, early transients and geometry. If assumptions or area are unknown, report measured relaxation/polarization and missing inputs instead of D.
gate.zh: 检查弛豫、早期瞬态与几何；假设或面积未知时，报告实测极化/弛豫及缺失参数，暂停给 D 值。

title.en: What transport information can PITT support?
title.zh: PITT 电位阶跃能支持哪些扩散结论？

inputs.en: Applied potential steps, measured current transients, timing, electrode geometry and applicable transport regime.
inputs.zh: 需要施加电位阶跃、电流瞬态、时间、几何参数及适用传输区间。

gate.en: PITT current transients are not interchangeable with GITT voltage relaxation. Charge transfer and capacitive contributions must be considered.
gate.zh: PITT 的电流瞬态不能直接套 GITT 的电压弛豫公式；须考虑电荷转移与电容贡献。

title.en: Can a physical model reproduce measured voltage?
title.zh: 物理模型能否解释实际电压响应？

inputs.en: Current/temperature protocol, voltage trace, cell design, chemistry-specific parameters and initial state.
inputs.zh: 需要电流/温度程序、电压记录、电池结构、体系参数与初始状态。

gate.en: Default parameter sets describe particular cells. Fit does not establish identifiability; do not transfer parameters silently to another chemistry.
gate.zh: 默认参数集对应特定电池；拟合误差小不代表参数可辨识，也不能直接跨化学体系移植。

title.en: What voltage response does an RC model predict?
title.zh: 给定 RC 参数，会产生怎样的电压响应？

inputs.en: User-approved OCV, current, R0, R1, time constant and pulse duration.
inputs.zh: 需要确认 OCV、电流、R0、R1、时间常数与脉冲时长。

gate.en: Actual forward computation is connected. Illustrative parameters, fixed OCV; not calibrated to the measured cell and not PyBaMM.
gate.zh: 已接入实际前向计算。使用说明性参数、固定 OCV；尚未对实测电池辨识参数，也不是 PyBaMM。

title.en: Does the prediction outperform simple baselines?
title.zh: 预测是否优于简单基线？

inputs.en: Aligned EIS/capacity histories and future labels for independent cells.
inputs.zh: 需要对齐的 EIS/容量历史，以及独立电池的未来实测标签。

gate.en: Connected now for the public cohort. Split by cell and time appropriately. Current default EIS model loses to persistence; this remains visible.
gate.zh: 公开数据已接入。按电池与时间正确划分；当前默认 EIS 模型不如沿用当前容量，保留此结果。
